habits.daily_routine: Collects data for wall newspaper profiles.
quirks: uses flirtation to pressure Ikki into an interview

background.pre_story: Saw the video of Ikki defeating Stella online and became his fan.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Admires him and wants to interview him.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Treats Stella's situation as headline material.
relationships.classmates: Helps guide classmates to safety during Stella and Shizuku's clash.

knowledge: online reaction to Ikki vs Stella
periods.summary: Kagami introduces herself as Ikki's fan after seeing his duel with Stella online, tries to secure an interview for a wall newspaper, adapts quickly when Manabe attacks, evacuates classmates during Stella and Shizuku's confrontation, and publishes profile-style wall newspaper inserts on Ikki, Stella and Shizuku.

key_events.summary: Approaches Ikki for an interview and witnesses his unarmed defeat of Manabe's group.
Evacuates classmates and reframes the incident as a scandal headline.
Provides profile commentary on Ikki, Stella and Shizuku.

periods.label: 壁报记者的追踪报道
periods.species: human / Blazer (student knight status not foregrounded)

personality.summary: Relentlessly nosy reporter whose stalking skills are strong enough to trail major fighters unnoticed.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Major article subject; she promotes his feats and titles.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Tracks Ayase after sensing news value in her match with Ikki.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Profiles him through Donrou contacts after the dojo duel.

periods.summary: Kagami's wall-newspaper profiles provide public data on Nagi, Ayase, Renren and Kuraudo. After sensing a story from Ikki and Ayase's selection-battle conversation, she tails Ikki, Stella and Ayase to the dojo duel, photographs the fight, and publishes the headline that the Worst One defeated Donrou's Sword Eater. Her report helps eliminate lingering doubt about Ikki's strength and sparks campus debate about Ikki versus Toka Todo.

key_events.summary: Publishes the dojo duel story with hidden photos, boosting Ikki's reputation.

periods.label: 记者的情报支援

status.current: supports Ikki with information and plans a feature on him

relationships.stella-vermillion: Explains press manipulation to her during the scandal.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Discusses Ikki's odds and later witnesses Shizuku's relief.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Believes in him and plans a wall-newspaper special after his final battle.

periods.summary: Kagami joins Stella, Shizuku and Alice at lunch to explain that the negative press about Ikki is being coerced by the Ethics Committee through media access threats. Her knowledge of journalism and League policy clarifies why expulsion is unlikely without manufactured evidence. She also writes the volume's wall-newspaper character profiles for Kanata, Utakata and Toka. On the final day she is among the students gathered to cheer Ikki at the gate and says her next wall newspaper will feature him.

key_events.summary: Explains the media pressure and League expulsion context.
Cheers Ikki and promises a feature.

periods.time: Secret daily-life interviews of Stella and Shizuku
periods.label: 秘密跟踪采访者

status.current: secretly tails Stella and Shizuku for informal interviews
status.health: exhausted by trying to keep up with Stella and Ikki's morning run

personality.summary: Curious, energetic and opportunistic; she treats student daily life as news material and jokes about using sensitive photos as leverage.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Tails Stella for a daily routine profile, admires her effort but mocks her enormous appetite and secretly photographs an embarrassing moment.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Tails Shizuku for a daily routine profile and notes her aloofness, healing role, food habits, brother complex and training effort.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Uses Ikki as a reference point for both profiles; his training pace defeats her stamina and his clothes become Stella's secret fixation.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Observes Alice protecting and sparring with Shizuku.

periods.summary: Kagami conducts two short secret-tailing interviews. While tailing Stella, she wakes before dawn, tries to keep up with Stella and Ikki's intense run, observes Stella's normal classes, huge cafeteria appetite, training with Ikki, and embarrassing habit of smelling Ikki's shirt. While tailing Shizuku, she records Shizuku's sleepy morning, role as class health representative and healer, quiet lunches, obsessive online replies in Ikki's fan thread, and repeated efforts to learn short-sword combat from Alice.

key_events.summary: Follows Stella through morning run, classes, lunch and training.
Follows Shizuku through morning dorm life, class duties, lunch habits and sparring.

periods.label: 加加美发现第八所学校

status.current: survives Alice's Fantasy-Form stabbing and warns Ikki by emergency call
status.achievement: independently identifies the Akatsuki infiltrator pattern

personality.summary: Nosy, ambitious and unusually capable as a student reporter; pursues anomalies even when they point to a dangerous conspiracy.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: His concern about Amane triggers her deeper investigation; she later warns him about Alice.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend and reporting companion who turns out to be the infiltrator that stabs her.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Becomes suspicious of him after Ikki asks about his sparse history.

periods.summary: Kagami reports from the joint training camp and trades information with other school journalists. After Ikki asks her about Amane, she investigates his odd six no-contest victories and the broader pattern of unknown first-year representatives. By cross-checking representatives, school records, board and sponsor information, she realizes that another hidden school exists behind the seven academies. Alice stabs her with Darkness Hermit before she can warn anyone, but Nango later finds her bound in a warehouse. She uses an emergency student-handbook broadcast to warn Ikki that Alice is an enemy spy, seconds before Akatsuki's planned ambush unfolds.

key_events.summary: Identifies the hidden Akatsuki pattern and is silenced by Alice.
Nango rescues her and she broadcasts a warning to Ikki.

periods.label: 加加美的助手艾莉丝
periods.species: human / Blazer or human (not clarified here)

status.current: not directly seen, but Alice works as her assistant at journalist gatherings

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Uses Alice as an assistant under the pretext of atonement after he attacked her in Fantasy Form; this also helps him avoid brooding.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Her wall-newspaper profiles appear as interludes describing major fighters.

periods.summary: Kagami does not directly appear in the Osaka scenes, but Alice explains that he is attending a general reporters' gathering with her rather than the representative banquet. Ikki understands that Kagami's demand for Alice's assistance is also kindness: it gives Alice a way to atone and stay connected after the Akatsuki incident. Her wall-newspaper character profiles provide interlude information on Ouma, Kiriko and Moroboshi.

key_events.summary: Alice says he will help Kagami at a journalists' gathering instead of attending the representative banquet.

periods.label: 新闻社记者解释商业乱流

status.current: covering Seven Stars and supporting Hagun representatives after their perfect first-round result

personality.summary: Energetic, sleep-deprived and media-savvy, yet sincerely grateful to Stella for avenging injured Hagun students.
fears: discouraging Stella by explaining the schedule consequences

relationships.stella-vermillion: Hugs and thanks Stella for fighting Akatsuki on behalf of Hagun, easing Stella's guilt.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Had previously investigated Amane for Ikki; explains media and schedule issues before Ikki's second-round match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Discusses the compressed schedule and Amane threat with her.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Chats with him while joining the Hagun observer group.

periods.summary: Kagami meets Ikki's group after staying up all night preparing articles about Hagun's unprecedented perfect first-round record. She explains that Stella's popularity drove global broadcast-rights bidding to an enormous level, so Stella's direct B-block advance created pressure from broadcasters and sponsors over lost match days. The committee responded by refunding part of the rights fees and compressing the schedule, causing second and third rounds to occur on one day. Kagami is careful to say Stella is not at fault, then hugs her and thanks her because Hagun students were thrilled to see Akatsuki punished for the school attack.

key_events.summary: Explains the broadcast-money reason for the accelerated schedule and reassures Stella.

periods.label: 破军壁报特别版主持人
titles: 破军学园新闻部突击采访组

status.role: frames the whole volume as a wall-newspaper special edition

personality.summary: Energetic, opportunistic and shamelessly curious; she turns private school incidents into reported 'scoops'.

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend and co-host whom she pressures into helping.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Lends Stella the otome game and enjoys teasing her reactions.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Admires his rise and wants photos or stories for the wall newspaper.

periods.summary: Kagami opens vol-08 by announcing a special wall-newspaper edition covering side incidents that missed normal deadlines. She and Alice introduce and comment on each episode. In the first short story she begs Ikki to repeat a sword demonstration for photos and later pushes the otome game 'Private Prince Academy' onto Stella, triggering the cultural-experience incident. The intermissions imply she has somehow collected private details that even Alice does not know.

key_events.summary: Launches the special edition and introduces the volume's side stories.
Lends Stella the otome game and handheld console.
